reconstruction.recipe: copy current src/scripts/package.json; replace src/core.js, src/game.js, src/tactics.js with git show 530288f; git apply validation/previous-volley-pass/source.patch

methodology.scope: Seeded CPU watch doubles, identical profiles and alternating starting service. Aggregate integration comparison, not isolated causal evidence or human-play evidence.
methodology.decisions: Observed accepted hit events on serving-side third/fifth/later odd contacts, not tentative chooseCpuShot calls. Shot is the final selected stroke (overhead/ATP/Erne included).
methodology.readiness: Reconstructed pre-hit context uses current caller thresholds for both engines; baseline did not necessarily consume these fields. transition means shots>=4, serving team, either teammate outside near-kitchen threshold.
methodology.depth: Feet from opponent baseline (team 0: y, team 1: 44-y). First emitted bounce only, including out/wrong-side/net landings. No extrapolated landings; missing bounces retain a status. Deep zone <=9 feet, denominator all serves/returns.
methodology.roles: Live tacticalRole integrated every fixed tick during rally; followThrough ends at next contact or rally end. Weak means quality<.8 or chosen-shot contact difficulty>.7.
methodology.limits: 40 simulated minutes per match; resumed reports reuse completed matches and restart incomplete matches from their seeds. Replay recording disabled, no engine source edits or additional random draws. Paired seeds diverge after decisions change; samples and within-rally contacts are correlated.

sampling: Evenly spaced observed event samples; summaries/counts use every event, including unsampled events.
